def _calibration(study):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(u), 1)
    coeff = []
    for (x, y) in zip(u.T, v.T):
        dx = x[i] - x[j]
        good = dx != 0
        gain = np.median((y[i] - y[j])[good] / dx[good])
        offset = np.median(y - gain * x)
        err = np.abs(y - offset - gain * x)
        keep = err <= max(0.001, 5 * np.median(err))
        coeff.append(_ls(_affine(x[keep]), y[keep]))
    (offset, gain) = np.asarray(coeff).T
    b = study['panel_b']
    mixing = _ls(_affine(b['u']), b['v'])
    return (offset, gain, mixing)

def _calibrate(panel):
    (u, v) = (panel['u'], panel['v'])
    design = [_calibration_features(u, j) for j in range(4)]
    rng = np.random.default_rng(37)
    best = np.inf
    for _ in range(48):
        rows = rng.choice(len(u), 8, replace=False)
        fit = np.column_stack([a @ _ls(a[rows], v[rows, j]) for (j, a) in enumerate(design)])
        errors = np.linalg.norm(v - fit, axis=1)
        score = np.median(errors)
        if score < best:
            best = score
            keep = errors <= 5 * score
    return np.array([_ls(a[keep], v[keep, j]) for (j, a) in enumerate(design)])
